summary: Iter52 — verified (1) Lighthouse Outreach module (backend + admin UI + public /tour) and (2) three authedDownload regressions on /shipper-intake, /boc3-compliance, /international. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (dashboard, prospects full lifecycle including all 6 stages + all 8 touch kinds, dup 409, 6 asset PDFs each %PDF-magic + >5KB, auto-touch on asset download with prospect_id, public /tour no-auth 200, public interest create + idempotent re-submit, intake submit_url uses PUBLIC_FRONTEND_URL, HouseBL+SLI PDFs, BOC-3 file route wired). Frontend: /lighthouse-outreach renders 4 tabs, prospects add/detail modal with all 6 stage movers + touch log + 6 collateral buttons work end-to-end; /tour loads in incognito-clean localStorage state and successfully POSTs interest without auth; shipper-intake PDF button downloads a valid 428KB PDF and all rendered submit URLs use the preview host (no orisei.example.com placeholder).

issues: Brand short_name inconsistency: the public tour endpoint returns the brand marked active in company_brand (currently 'Walmart · Save Money. Live Better.'), while the authenticated topbar/header shows 'Orisei · Lighthouse Outreach' (uses the useBranding provider's cached/scoped brand). Prospects visiting /tour see 'Walmart Freight Solutions LLC' in the footer — cosmetic but confusing for a TMS-buyer-facing landing page. Root cause: multiple rows in company_brand have active=true, so _active_brand returns whichever Mongo picks. Consider enforcing single-active constraint or biasing to short_name=='Orisei'.

'Send collateral' buttons open the PDF in a new tab and toast 'Delivered · touch logged', but do NOT actually send anything (no email is dispatched). The label 'Send' is misleading — recommend renaming to 'Preview & Log' or 'Open PDF + Log Touch' to match observed behavior.

action_items: OPTIONAL / cosmetic: dedupe company_brand.active=true so /tour and admin topbar show the same brand short_name (currently Walmart on /tour, Orisei on admin).
OPTIONAL / UX: rename Lighthouse 'Send collateral' → 'Preview & log touch' since it opens in a new tab rather than actually emailing the prospect.

OPTIONAL / hardening: the create_prospect dup-check regex is not escaped — a company_name containing regex metacharacters ('.', '(', etc.) could bypass the 409 or explode. Use re.escape or Mongo $eq with $options:'i' via collation.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/lighthouse.py:340 — dup detection uses `$regex: f'^{payload.company_name}$'` with no escape. A user submitting `Acme.*` would match every company. Wrap with re.escape() or use collation-insensitive $eq.

routes/lighthouse.py:423 — /assets/{kind}.pdf endpoint autodownloads a 'download' touch even if prospect_id is a valid ID but does NOT belong to any active/legitimate outreach session. There's no rate-limit; a caller could pass any prospect_id and pollute the touch log. Consider tying the auto-touch to the caller (only log if the caller is admin/dispatcher — already gated by user_dep, so OK — but no check that prospect belongs to the actor's tenant).

LighthouseOutreach.jsx:442 downloadAsset() manually re-implements authedDownload (fetch + Bearer + blob URL). Reuse the shared authedDownload helper to avoid drift and get built-in error/toast handling.

PublicTour.jsx:35 — form submission catches all errors as generic 'Submission failed'. If backend returns 422 (validation), the visitor gets no clue what field is wrong. Surface response.json().detail into the toast.

LighthouseOutreach.jsx PublicTab.copyLink() uses `window.location.origin` — during embedded/iframe previews (e.g. some admin panels) origin could be wrong. Prefer BACKEND_URL replacement or a backend-served /api/lighthouse/config that returns the canonical public URL.

routes/lighthouse.py:_render_asset_pdf allocates 200+ line markdown blob and stringifies dates inline. Fine for now but consider caching the six baseline PDFs (no prospect_id) — every call rebuilds them.

The public interest endpoint auto-creates a 'website'-sourced prospect but ignores the utm_source/utm_campaign from the POST body — bug: fields are declared in the payload model but the create branch overwrites `source: 'website'` unconditionally and only stores utm_source/utm_campaign. Should either respect payload.source or drop it from the model.

LighthouseOutreach.jsx is 706 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Command Deck, Prospects, Assets, Public tabs are all internal — split into pages/lighthouse/ subdirectory when the next feature lands.
seed_data_creation: During tests created + deleted several TEST_LH_*, TEST_LH_ASSET_*, TEST_LH_PUB_*, and TEST_UI_LH_* prospects (cleanup verified). Preserved seed prospect 'LH-20C41A772E' (Beacon Logistics) was NOT deleted — test only checked existence and passes whether present (200) or absent (404).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter52 covers the Lighthouse Outreach module + branded download regressions. test_iter52_lighthouse.py at /app/backend/tests/ can be used as regression tests going forward. Two visible-but-cosmetic issues remain: (1) brand name inconsistency between /tour ('Walmart') and admin ('Orisei') — root cause is duplicate active=true rows in company_brand; (2) 'Send collateral' button labelled 'Send' but actually only opens PDF + logs a download touch (no email actually leaves the system). Neither blocks any requested functionality. Public /tour form POST logs 'Failed to load resource: 401' in console — those are the SPA's normal auth-required calls (branding, /me, etc.) firing before the router recognizes /tour as a public route; the actual /tour page still renders successfully. Confirmed by clearing localStorage and re-submitting the form successfully.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found — all requested regressions verified fixed. The authedDownload signature+path fixes are correct: ShipperIntake.jsx L126, Boc3Compliance.jsx L363, and International.jsx L189/195 all now call authedDownload('/api/…', {filename: …}) — matches the helper's (path, options) signature and hits the /api-prefixed routes that pass through the ingress. Backend PUBLIC_FRONTEND_URL properly propagates into intake submit_url (no orisei.example.com in any of the 4 existing intake rows).
